component.name: Kodex
component.summary: A native KDE client for Codex

description.p: Kodex is a native Qt Quick and Kirigami desktop client for the Codex app-server. It talks to the same local daemon as the Codex command line tool, so your account, profile and saved sessions are shared.

ul.li: Projects, tasks and the sessions you started from the command line, including sessions without a project
Streaming answers, plans, questions and approval requests
Attach files, pictures and clipboard screenshots; see the pictures Codex opens or creates
Git panel with the working tree, the staged diff and the diff made by Codex
Updates, remote control pairing and proxy settings

description.p: Kodex is an independent project. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by OpenAI.

screenshot.caption: A task with Codex, pictures in the conversation and the Git panel
